books.title: The Keeper of Gull Rock
books.author: Tamsin Hale
books.summary: The last keeper of a small lighthouse spends one more autumn on the rock before the light runs itself.

books.title: Bread Without Hurry
books.author: Owen Marsh
books.summary: A plain guide to slow bread at home: what flour, water and salt do, how long to wait, and when to stop worrying.

books.title: Letters from the Night Train
books.author: Ada Lindqvist
books.summary: Two letters written on a sleeper train, one as it leaves the city and one as it reaches the border at dawn.
